items.question: Which deities and actions must the guru address at the doors following the morning preparations?
premises: The doors are ritually addressed as part of the sequence.
The lords associated with the doors are worshipped.
The great sovereign goddess is raised or invoked afterward.
items.inference: After the morning preparations, the guru must worship the doors and their guardian lords and then raise the great sovereign goddess.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat in relation to patīn is contextually inferred as the doors' lords.
The precise ritual sense of samutthāpya (raising, awakening, or installing) depends on broader ritual context.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped the doors and their lords, and having raised the great sovereign goddess.
